overview: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed funding availability, project priorities, and an application from ABCD for the Medford Move-In program. The committee expedited and approved a recommendation for $144,250 in matching funds for the Riverside Plaza shade structure project.

items.title: Medford Move-In Program Presentation
items.summary: Tondo Dube of ABCD presented a three-year funding request of $99,989 to provide move-in rental assistance for low-income Medford residents, and answered member questions regarding past expenditures and administrative costs.

items.title: Application Deliberations and Financial Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed available CPA funds totaling approximately $2.7 million against $2.3 million in requests, noting the withdrawal of the St. Francis Church project and an application change swapping City Hall bathrooms for City Hall Council Chamber window restoration.

items.title: Riverside Plaza Shade Structure Funding
items.summary: Approved a recommendation of $144,250 in CPA funds to provide matching funds for a state PARC grant for shade structures and improvements at Riverside Plaza.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes for October 8 and October 22, 2024.
